question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Mothers have great __animosity__ for their children.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"affection"** means a gentle feeling of fondness or liking. (स्नेह)

 
 
• **Example:** The mother's affection for her child was evident in her every action.
 
 
 
• The word **"animosity"** refers to a strong feeling of dislike or hatred. (द्वेष)
 
 
• **Example:** There was a clear animosity between the two rivals.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word to use in the sentence is **"affection"**, not "animosity".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Affectation** (दिखावा): Behavior, speech, or writing that is artificial and designed to impress.

 
 
• **Example:** His British accent is just an affectation; he’s never even been to the UK.
 
 
 
• **Absurdity** (मूर्खता): The quality or state of being ridiculous or wildly unreasonable.
 
 
• **Example:** The absurdity of the situation made everyone laugh.
 
 
 
• **Abasement** (अपमान): The action or fact of abasing or being abased; humiliation or degradation.
 
 
• **Example:** The abasement of the employee in front of his colleagues was uncalled for.
